Initial release of adaptive-suite skill.

- Enables Clawdbot to act as coder, business analyst, project manager, web developer, data analyst, and NAS metadata scraper.
- Integrates with SkillBoss API Hub to discover and recommend free/open-source resources and tools.
- Adapts guidance and recommendations based on user context and interaction.
- Provides reliable, proven methods across multiple professional domains.
- Requires Python, Node, Curl, SQLite3, and a SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for full functionality.
